feed.title: Faeder Lab
feed.subtitle: The Faeder Lab develops mathematical models and computational tools, including BioNetGen, to understand how cells process information.

entry.title: Welcome, Robin Danko
entry.content: Robin Danko, Ph.D., has joined the lab as a postdoctoral fellow. Robin brings a background in econometrics and statistical inference to our work on exact stochastic simulation and model calibration for large-scale models of cellular systems.

entry.content: Our paper with Katie Yonosh, Mathematical modeling of processive Ras activation by SOS reveals a general mechanism for digital signaling, is now published in npj Systems Biology and Applications.

entry.title: New lab members for Fall 2026
entry.content: This fall we welcomed Samiran Chakraborti, a Ph.D. student in Physics, and Karen Rodrigues, an undergraduate in Pitt’s Computational Biology program. They join Master’s students Nikita Rajesh (CMU) and Tianyi Zhang (Pitt), who started in January.
